entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: Wh-Who are you!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: Could you be... the Phantom Thieves!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: Hahahaha! So you wanna change[n]my heart, even after everything[n]I've done for you guys!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: ME, of all people...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: If you just shut up and listened to[n]what I told you, the Phantom Thieves[n]would get even more famous...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: And if you did that, I'd get some[n]of the spotlight too. I wouldn't[n]be just some stupid zero anymore...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: There's finally some hope back in[n]my life... So why? Why are you so[n]insistent on stopping me...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: Yo, losers. Get out of here.

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I wanna talk to your leader... alone.

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: This is all your fault...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: Before you came along, I knew my[n]role in life. I was supposed to be[n]the guy everyone messed with...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I had accepted that I was[n]a zero, embraced it even...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: But once I figured out you were[n]one of the Phantom Thieves,[n]everything changed...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: You just HAD to get close to me...!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I mean, seeing a real-life hero[n]do all this amazing stuff made me[n]wish I could be something more...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I want to change society too...[n]I want the world to notice me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: If I can just make the Phantom Thieves[n]famous, maybe I'll end up famous too...!
You're riding our coattails.
Would that really satisfy you?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: C-Can you really blame me!?[n]Look at how boring I am!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: But you guys... you're special.[n]You have the ability to change[n]people... to change the world...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: In the end, that's why I need you[n]guys... You're the only way I'll[n]be able to make a name for myself!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I'm not sure... but I don't have[n]any other choice!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I don't have any special powers[n]like you guys... Heck, nobody[n]even pays attention to me...!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: In the end, that's why I need you guys...[n]You're the only way I'll be able to make[n]a name for myself!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I know it's wrong...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: But if I can't push my way into[n]the spotlight now, when will I...!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: A-Anyway, just bring it on already![n]You're here to fight, aren't you!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: Wh-What...? You aren't going to[n]change my heart...?
Do it yourself.
We're leaving.
There's no need.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's go.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm sure he learned something[n]if he's been spendin' all this[n]time with us amazin' heroes, yeah?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We don't have time to be dealing[n]with his pubescent problems.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If he's really such a big fan, he[n]should know how a true member of[n]the Phantom Thieves would act here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mishima-kun is the kind of guy[n]who realizes his own mistakes.[n]This should be enough for today.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed, it would be quite cruel[n]to corner him any further.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I expect he will come to realize[n]the true difference between what[n]is right and what is wrong...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't think there's[n]much else I can add here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mishima-kun has been with you even[n]longer than I have... so he should[n]know well what you stand for.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mishima's kinda like I was. I'm[n]pretty sure he knows he can't[n]keep going like he is now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He just need to do it one step[n]at a time. He'll be fine.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes, fighting is not always[n]the most appropriate answer...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Besides, I'm sure Mishima-kun[n]has already found the truth of[n]the matter within himself.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A wise decision, [fName].

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: He has already realized the error[n]in his ways. Now we must see if he[n]can face the truth of that mistake.

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: N-No...! I need the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I need to be famous...!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mishima
entries.en: I need to...
